{{Top|leg}}
The '''Order of the Kilmar Bange''' was a secret society that accepted only pro-[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[House Melantha|Melantha]] alumni of the [[Raithal Academy/Legends|Raithal Academy]]. Graduates of the [[Corulag Academy]] qualified for associate membership to the order.

The goals of the order were to promote brotherhood among its members, uphold the honor of House Melantha and the Empire and strengthen the association between Melantha and Coruscant.
